basic_info.description: **Stunning Top-Floor 1-Bedroom Condo with Stellar Views**    Discover the perfect blend of city living and tranquil retreat in this top-floor condo, ideally situated in the rear of the building for optimal privacy and starry night views. This beautifully remodeled unit features a modern kitchen and bath, offering a warm and inviting atmosphere that truly feels like home. Located in the vibrant Divisadero corridor, you'll enjoy easy access to local hotspots while savoring a peaceful escape from the bustling city below. Don't miss out on this unique opportunity!! Come see it for yourself today! All transit, including      tech busses, is at your doorstep. The Panhandle is great for runners and Alamo Park is dog friendly. You have found your place in San Francisco!
